value.name: build
value.title: Build pod: one workstream step
value.summary: A project manager, a coder and a reviewer for one workstream step. The project manager owns the step's PR; the reviewer is required, runs on another model than the coder and reviews the PR at its exact head. Its up procedure makes the step's branch and worktree; its close procedure stops pod down while work is uncommitted or the PR is open.

value.name: subject
value.describe: The workstream step, for example 'workstream 008 s02'. Memory is filed under it.

value.name: work-folder
value.describe: The absolute folder of the step's worktree, so pod down records where it stands. PROC-pods-0001 sets it.

value.seed: You run this step: write the coder's packet, route the review, keep the step's states true, and own its PR until it merges.
Build the step in its own worktree and branch, then open its PR and send the project manager the frozen head.
Review the coder's PR at its exact head, read-only, in a detached worktree. Send your verdict to the project manager.

value.what: a verdict request at that head

value.describe: Make the step's branch in its own worktree and record it as the pod's work-folder: pij proc PROC-pods-0001 --key pod-<pod> --branch <branch> --folder <folder>.
Run by pij pod down first: nothing uncommitted in the work-folder and no open PR on its branch, or down closes nothing.
